en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5619 - Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan Al-Saffar (may Allah (swt) be pleased with him) wrote to Abu Muhammad Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari (as) asking about a man who passed away, leaving behind his daughter's daughter and his full brother.
Imam (as) replied: "The inheritance belongs to the closest relative, Allah (swt) willing."
